solution: I needed to attend a mandatory high table dinner and was asked to indicate which courses I prefer to eat before the deadline. In the evening when I attended the high table dinner, I arrived punctually. I did not finish every course in my three-course meal because I don't like its taste. Therefore I asked the waiter to collect the remains each time he serves the next course and thus my courses are eventually gone.
canonical_facts: Courses means dishes at a mandatory high-table dinner, not academic classes
The deadline is for meal preferences
The student attends on time but dislikes the food and leaves portions of the three-course meal
At the student’s request the waiter clears leftovers when serving each next dish, so all courses disappear
